نزدهف (form VIII)
# نَزْدَهِفُ (nazdahifu) /naz.da.hi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# نُزْدَهَفُ (nuzdahafu) /nuz.da.ha.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# نَزْدَهِفَ (nazdahifa) /naz.da.hi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَهَفَ (izdahafa)
# نُزْدَهَفَ (nuzdahafa) /nuz.da.ha.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
